title: Emergency!

title: Emergency!

S2 E9 — Women!
An outspoken, feminist journalist covering the paramedics manages to alienate both the fire department and Rampart Emergency staff.

DeSoto maneuvers Gage into a blind date with his wife's cousin; Brackett must operate on a newlywed husband felled by gunshot wounds.

description:

description:

title: The A-Team
description:

description:

description:

title: The A-Team
description:

A group of senior citizens protects a scientist's teenage daughter from the KGB; guests Lew Ayres, John McLiam.

title: The A-Team
description:

Assassins setting a trap for the attorney general hold Murdock, Frankie and wounded Face prisoner in a restaurant.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E2 — The Children of Jamestown
The rest of the team is caught while Murdock flies a girl to freedom from a religious paramilitary cult; guest John Saxon.

description:

A boy (Meeno Peluce) whose brother (William Smith) has been unlawfully imprisoned asks his friend B.A. for help; guest Ken Norton.
